rows.inspection_limits: Ji et al. 2020, scientific Summary; PMID:32339992. Direct primary XML at https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/PMC7186526/fullTextXML and actual Figure 1 inspected. Introduction and Results group constricting rings, adhesive networks, columns and knobs as four representative devices, not an exhaustive taxonomy. Selected Transparent Methods and actual PDF pages 8, 11, 12, 15 and 16 were inspected; not every supplement figure or dataset. The main Introduction describes serial column cells while PDF 12 allows one or more; that narrower child-scope question remains open. Adhesion-gene expansion and expression correlations do not establish a universal molecular mechanism or sequence-only phenotype prediction. Native abstract verifier: VERIFIED.

rows.inspection_limits: Yang et al. 2011, Author Summary, not the scientific abstract; PMID:21909256. Direct primary XML at https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/PMC3164635/fullTextXML and actual Figure 1 inspected. Panel I shows interconnected loops; the caption distinguishes formation, attraction, adhesion, capture, penetration and digestion. These are separate endpoints, not automatic consequences of an observed shape. This parent curation did not renew the full Methods/supplement audit retained by the net child. The old teleomorph wording is not imported as a current taxonomic equivalence. Shares authors with Ji 2020, not independent-laboratory replication. rows.inspection_limits: Chen et al. 2023, Results, Morphogenesis and development of CR; PMID:37968349. CR means constricting ring. Primary XML at https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/PMC10651832/fullTextXML, relevant formation/inflation Methods and actual Figure 1 inspected. Strain 29 (CGMCC3.20198) forms morphologically complete rings before inflation competence; panels l/m contrast immature-ring escape with mature-ring capture. Water-agar induction with C. elegans, horse-serum formation and hot-water inflation are distinct assays, not universal requirements. Later protein-mechanism figures and supplements were not fully audited; the incomplete supplementary ZIP is not evidence. No universal SNARE dependency or natural-strain exemplar is inferred. Native verifier: NOT_IN_ABSTRACT; the Results span matches directly.

rows.inspection_limits: Saikawa and Takahashi 2002, Figure 8 caption, page 418. All three pages and actual Figures 1-20 inspected at https://www.jstage.jst.go.jp/article/mycosci/43/5/43_MYC43417/_pdf. Figures 8-14 and 15-20 document nonconstricting rings in source-named Dactylella leptospora and Dactylaria candida; Figures 1-7 show the constricting comparator. Curved hyphal branches form the traps. The observations support inclusion of nonconstricting rings, not universal stalk lengths, culture conditions or adhesion proteins. Adhesive ultrastructure is attributed to earlier work, not newly imaged here. DOI/title reconciled against Crossref. Native verifier: UNRESOLVED with no result for that exact DOI query; the caption matches directly. This does not assert that the paper is unindexed everywhere.

scope.inference: Existing child definitions entail specialized hyphal trap differentiation. Not five new experiments.
scope.preservation: Only direct parents, parent-gap resolutions, and one separate column-scope question change; child definitions/evidence/examples/mechanism gaps and prior history remain.

column_question.prompt: Reconcile serial-cell column scope with the supplement's broader cell-count description.
column_question.rationale: The current definition retains serially arranged cells, supported by Ji's Introduction. The newly inspected 2020 Transparent Methods, Fungal strains, PDF page 12, describes columns containing one or more cells. Preserve this source-level difference pending review of single-cell columns versus knobs; do not silently broaden the child or make cell number the sole discriminator. Both usages fit fungal nematode-trap formation, so this question does not reopen the resolved parent gap. The supplement names YMF1.00569 from Deqin soil, not the 2016 paper's YMF1.01472. That provenance does not establish identity between the strains or a canonical example. The earlier evidence notes record limited supplement access at initial curation; this follow-up adds the inspected page without claiming a complete supplement audit.

dispositions: TraitMech canonical matches are the five narrower trap morphologies, autophagy and myzocytosis. Their proposals and supporting writers/tests/history are not an exact umbrella. Child definitions and all five parent gaps were read in full.

CommunityMech canonical matches are ten bacterial community/host records. The six historical lines absent from current TYQ1 concern bacterial rhizosphere restructuring, biofilm cohesion and nematode inhibition, not fungal trap differentiation.

Other historical paths are generated views, validation/review reports, existing-child history, known research leads and a rejected nematode-pharyngeal regrounding. They are not new parent definitions.

Reference-cache contexts concern bacterial colonization, host assays, biocontrol, taxonomy, HSPRO1/2 annotations and bibliographies. PMID38228683 cites fungal olfactory luring, a research lead rather than a curated trap parent. These cached excerpts are not counted as newly verified primary evidence.
